selection_rule: Highest mean of Y3S1 and Y3S2 validation mean_mastery_change on the common scenario bank (Y3S1 seeds 81000+episode, Y3S2 seeds 82000+episode), shared by every candidate. Ties use the lowest seed. The held-out bank is not used.

definitions.primary: Mean, over topics available at episode start, of final mastery minus initial mastery. Synthetic. Not accuracy, not a real-student effect.
definitions.weakest_topic: Mastery change of the available topic with the lowest mastery at episode start.
definitions.return: Sum of actual clipped mastery changes, plus -0.2 for an invalid action. Not accuracy. Not the se-path-multi-v1 return.
definitions.no_progress_rate: Share of valid steps whose clipped mastery change on the selected topic is 0.
definitions.valid_steps: Valid simulator steps. Not verified student completion and not self-report.
